drafted_from: Three independent accounts of the same three timing conditions. The example signs and thresholds are invented; the reversible decisions are a planning safeguard.
start_here: Help me tell whether this pickup coordination idea is ready for one small test.
no_lists_because: This workflow asks for three evidence notes and returns a decision without reading or changing stored lists.
instructions: Name the idea and the people it is for.
Give one evidence note each for technology, economics, and readiness.
Read the next move and the observation that would change it; do not launch.

worked_examples.title: Three observed conditions
worked_examples.ask: Can I run one pickup planning rehearsal?
worked_examples.given: A working integration, a route comparison and example shops already coordinating pickups.
worked_examples.hands_back: One reversible rehearsal with a stop signal.

weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.idea: Shared pickup planning for neighborhood repair shops
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.intended_users: Repair shops with several pickup partners

technology.evidence: A synthetic integration test sent a correct pickup change to every participant.
technology.what_would_change_it: Errors in a larger rehearsal would remove this positive signal.

economics.evidence: Five synthetic route comparisons found fewer trips than separate pickups.
economics.what_would_change_it: Count wait time as a cost when checking the route.

readiness.evidence: Two example shops already share pickup times in chat.
readiness.what_would_change_it: Test whether they will keep participating when a change needs confirmation.

weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.reason: The integration works in the example and shops already coordinate the job; time savings still need observation.
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.next_move: Run one reversible pickup rehearsal with the two example shops.
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.reversal_signal: Pause if wait time wipes out the savings or shops stop coordinating.

worked_examples.title: Find the missing comparison
worked_examples.ask: What is my next test if I have not compared pickup costs?
worked_examples.given: The integration and behavior are observed but economics is not.
worked_examples.hands_back: One evidence check, not a launch.

weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.idea: Shared pickup planning for neighborhood repair shops
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.intended_users: Repair shops with several pickup partners

technology.evidence: A synthetic integration test sent a correct pickup change to every participant.
technology.what_would_change_it: Errors in a larger rehearsal would remove this positive signal.

economics.evidence: No travel or waiting time comparison is available.
economics.what_would_change_it: Measure trips and waiting time against the current practice.

readiness.evidence: Two example shops already share pickup times in chat.
readiness.what_would_change_it: Test whether they will keep participating when a change needs confirmation.

weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.reason: A working integration does not establish an economic reason for the shops to switch.
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.next_move: Compare actual pickup travel and waiting time before proposing a trial.
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.reversal_signal: Resume timing review once the same comparison includes both costs.

worked_examples.title: Wait for reliable notifications
worked_examples.ask: Should I ask people to try the system when dispatch notifications did not arrive?
worked_examples.given: A required capability failed in a synthetic rehearsal.
worked_examples.hands_back: Wait for the stated reliability condition before proposing a test.

weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.idea: Shared pickup planning for neighborhood repair shops
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.intended_users: Repair shops with several pickup partners

technology.evidence: The invented rehearsal failed to notify a participant on each of three changes.
technology.what_would_change_it: A repeatable test shows every participant is notified.

economics.evidence: Five synthetic route comparisons found fewer trips than separate pickups.
economics.what_would_change_it: Count wait time as a cost when checking the route.

readiness.evidence: Two example shops already share pickup times in chat.
readiness.what_would_change_it: Test whether they will keep participating when a change needs confirmation.

weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.reason: A missed pickup change means the essential notification path cannot be relied on.
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.next_move: Wait until the integration reliably delivers changes before asking shops to try it.
weigh-three-timing-signals-and-choose-on.reversal_signal: Every participant receives every update during a repeated fixture rehearsal.
